name: loadtest-stub-agent
//: NOT a workspace member and never installed. It exists to declare what the two sources beside it import, which is what `loadtest-boot.sh stub` copies over a scaffolded project that already links both. Without it Biome's noUndeclaredDependencies resolves these imports against the repo ROOT manifest and reports every one — and the alternative, excluding the directory from the linter, is the exclusion `packages/aai-templates/CLAUDE.md` records as having hidden a real bug in shipped code.
